verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms that Vanta has a Trust Center that 'automates time-consuming security reviews' (vanta-docs-19), but nothing shows the trust center updating itself from the platform. There is no evidence of automatically published subprocessor lists, document renewal syncing, or live control status on the trust center. Continuous control monitoring and TPRM vendor discovery are adjacent platform features, and the evidence never links them to trust-center content, so they earn no credit here.
